statements.statement: The patient has a history of recurrent syncope
The patient has transient episodes of cerebral ischemia
The patient has a known diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmias or pauses
The procedure was performed under CPT 93229
The related diagnosis codes are G45.9, I49.5, and R55
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
